title: Vagus nerve-mediated neuroimmune modulation for rheumatoid arthritis: a pivotal randomized controlled trial
observations_or_assays: ACR20 response referenced to consent baseline
time_scope: Month 3 before open-label stimulation, using each endpoint’s actual baseline and threshold.
excluded: ACR20 referenced to day-0 randomization, other thresholds and open-label follow-up
population_or_material: The main randomized efficacy population of RESET-RA.
requested_items: Blinded month-three primary ITT responder count/proportion and one treatment difference/CI/test for each criterion. Keep consent baseline and labeled multiplicity adjustment. Exclude duplicate registry/article representations, later open-label outcomes and alternative responder thresholds.
case_specific_rules: Use the requested consent-baseline blinded month-three responder endpoints; exclude day-zero-randomization ACR20. Recover the HAQ-DI MCID criterion and direction from the original source. Apply the shared rules for unreported inequality boundaries and use the supplementary instrument scoring rules.
